title: Hecke Subalgebras and Local Newforms for the Metaplectic Double Cover of $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{Q}_p)$
summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime, and let $\overline{\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z}_p)}$ and $\overline{K_0(p^n)}$ denote the inverse images of $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z}_p)$ and the congruence subgroup $K_0(p^n)$ in the metaplectic double cover $\widetilde{\mathrm{SL}}_2(\mathbb{Q}_p)$. For $n\geq2$, we study the subalgebra of the genuine Hecke algebra $H(\widetilde{\mathrm{SL}}_2(\mathbb{Q}_p)//\overline{K_0(p^n)},η)$ consisting of functions supported in $\overline{\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z}_p)}$, where $η$ is the genuine extension of either the trivial or the nontrivial quadratic character modulo $p$.
